title: Zoho One / CRM Specialist for Nonprofit Contact Management

facts: Post: mental health nonprofit on Zoho One, Google Workspace for Nonprofits and AppSheet; Office Manager is internal project lead.

Post asks for one contact record per person holding multiple roles (participants, volunteers, facilitators, employees, sponsors, donors, network contacts, board members), organization records linked to people, and permissions for view, edit, export and administer.
Post asks to recommend the master source per record type, duplicate rules and consistent identifiers, and to train an internal lead and a backup administrator.
Business name stated in the post; no person's name used. All people, organizations and records in the deck are invented.

cover.beat: Here's how your contacts would work. Someone who volunteers, gives and sits on the board stays one contact, with everything about them linked to that record.

scenes.title: A new gift finds the person you already know
scenes.caption: Maya already volunteers with you. When she gives at the walk, the form updates her contact instead of creating a second one.
scenes.beat: Follow Maya through it. She fills in the gift form at the walk. The system matches her email and phone to the contact she already has as a volunteer, adds the donor role, links the gift and her credit union, and applies the right access.
details: Matching order: email first, then phone plus last name. Close matches go to a review list for your lead.
The contact ID {{person.id}} is shared with AppSheet so both systems point at the same person.
Press Replay to watch Maya's gift move through each step, or Show result to see where it lands.
